definition: to speak in a loud voice
description: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

en.question: What is the man in front doing?

de.answer: Er schreit mit weit ausgebreiteten Armen.
de.question: Was macht der Mann vorne?

es.answer: Está gritando con los brazos abiertos de par en par.
